exclusions.name: Other council members or alternates
exclusions.why_safe: The council has exactly five members as per e1; no alternates or substitutes are mentioned in the evidence.

exclusions.name: Remote participation
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules require physical presence and no remote provision exists (e4), so remote voting is impossible.

exclusions.name: Public comment or procedural delays
exclusions.why_safe: The agenda lists final action (e2), and rules allow voting unless postponed (e11); no evidence suggests public comment would prevent a vote.
